Name: Daniela Pereda
Bio: Daniela is a sophomore from Cincinnati, Ohio, majoring in Electrical Engineering with minors in both French and Engineering Corporate Practice. Apart from ELC, she is a Physics tutor with the LRC and is involved in her residence hall, Johnson Family Hall, where she serves as the Sports & Wellness Chair and works in the dorm restaurant. In her free time, she loves to run, cook or bake, spend time with family and friends, and volunteer.

Name: Luke Fariborzian
Bio: Luke Fariborzian is a junior Electrical Engineering major on the pre-med track in Graham Family Hall, serving as Corporate Committee Head for ELC this year. In addition to ELC he is involved with enableND and the ND swim club.
